name: Stackable magnitude corrections of the guided prediction (megapack)
plain: Pulls the guided prediction's size back toward the conditional one after any mix rule. Six methods, each blended with strength; several CFGP_Correct nodes chain and apply in the order wired. Each runs in its own default space: rescale_std in v (x0 on flow), norm_cap, percentile_rescale and soft_clip in x0, channel and energy matching in noise. norm_cap solves a quadratic for the largest step along the push that keeps the norm under the cap; percentile_rescale only ever shrinks; soft_clip is the Reinhard curve applied to the per-pixel push past the conditional prediction.
math:
Symbols: d guided, d_c conditional, d_u unconditional (in the method's space); G = d − d_c; s strength; out = s·corr + (1 − s)·d.
rescale_std: corr = d·std(d_c)/std(d), per sample.
norm_cap: if ‖d‖ > κ‖d_c‖: β = (−⟨d_c,G⟩ + √(⟨d_c,G⟩² + (κ²−1)‖G‖²‖d_c‖²))/‖G‖², clamped to [0,1]; corr = d_c + β·G.
channel_norm_match: per pixel corr = d·‖d_c‖_ch/‖d‖_ch.
energy_preserve: corr = d·√(Σd_c²/Σd²).
percentile_rescale: ref = d_u + m(d_c − d_u); per channel k = min(q_p|ref − μ_ref| / q_p|d − μ_d|, 1); corr = (d − μ_d)·k + μ_d.
soft_clip: n = ‖G‖_ch; top = softness·(mean n + 5·std n); corr = d_c + G·(n/top)/(n/top + 1)·top/n.

props.params: method=rescale_std, strength=0.7, cap_ratio=1.05, mimic_scale=4, percentile=0.995, softness=1, space=auto
